import dimod
import pennylane as qml
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble
from qiskit_algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit_algorithms.apis.qaoa import QAOAAnalyzer
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA

def solve_water_grid_isolation():
    # Define graph and create bipartite graph for QAOA
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    G_bipartite = nx.bipartite.bipartite_projected_graph(G)

    # Define weights for QAOA cost function
    weights = {(i, j): flow if (i, j) in edges else 0 for i, j, flow in zip(edges, [5, 3, 6, 4, 2, 5, 7, 3, 4, 6])}

    # Define QAOA problem and solver
    qaoa = QAOA(G_bipartite, p=3, q=3, cost_function=lambda x: sum(weights[e] * dimod.binary_quadratic_model.var_product(x[e]) for e in G_bipartite.edges))
